hello.label: HELLO
hello.description: Open hand with fingers together moves outward from temple/forehead in a salute-like motion.

thank you.label: THANK YOU
thank you.description: Fingertips of dominant flat hand touch chin and move forward towards the person.

please.label: PLEASE
please.description: Open flat hand rubs chest in a clockwise circular motion.

welcome.label: WELCOME
welcome.description: Open hand sweeps inward towards body in an inviting gesture.

yes.label: YES
yes.description: Fist (S hand) nods up and down from the wrist like a nodding head.

no.label: NO
no.description: Index and middle fingers tap against thumb like a closing beak.

help.label: HELP
help.description: Closed fist with thumb up rests on open flat palm, and both hands lift together.

good.label: GOOD
good.description: Fingertips touch lips, then hand moves down to rest on flat palm of other hand.

morning.label: MORNING
morning.description: Dominant arm rises like the sun over the horizon formed by the non-dominant arm.

good morning.label: GOOD MORNING
good morning.description: Compound sign: GOOD followed by MORNING.

how are you.label: HOW ARE YOU
how are you.description: Curved hands rotate outward followed by pointing forward.

sign.label: SIGN
sign.description: Index fingers revolve around each other in alternating backward circles.

friend.label: FRIEND
friend.description: Index fingers hook together, then flip and hook the opposite way.

goodbye.label: GOODBYE
goodbye.description: Open hand with fingers together waves forward and back.

name.label: NAME
name.description: Index and middle fingers of both hands form H shapes and tap twice crosswise.
